name: Dire Shroomclaw
source: Starfinder Murder in Metal City Deluxe Adventure

offensiveAbilities.name: Entangling Mycelia
offensiveAbilities.description: Creatures hit by a shroomclaw's claw Strike are Clumsy 1 for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pounce
offensiveAbilities.description: The shroomclaw Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the shroomclaw began this action Hidden, it remains hidden until after its Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Suppressing Spores
offensiveAbilities.description: The shroomclaw releases a 10ft Type:burst of spores around itself that deal 2d4 Poison Damage damage to all non-shroomclaw creatures in the area (Basic DC 15 Fortitude Saving Throw save); on a critical failure, the creature becomes Suppressed for 1 minute. The shroomclaw can't use suppressing spores again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
